title: Stripe — Financial infrastructure for the internet

findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) could be faster
findings.description: LCP of 1900ms is in the 'good' range but could be improved. The hero animation delays content visibility.
findings.recommendation: Consider making the hero animation optional or reducing its duration for faster content display.

findings.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
findings.description: Marketing scripts and A/B testing tools contain 85KB of unused code.
findings.recommendation: Code-split marketing scripts and load A/B testing tools on demand.

findings.title: Interactive elements not keyboard accessible
findings.description: 2 custom dropdown menus in the navigation are not reachable via keyboard navigation.
findings.recommendation: Add tabindex='0' and keyboard event handlers to custom interactive elements.

findings.title: Focus indicators missing on some interactive elements
findings.description: The CTA button and form inputs lack visible focus indicators, making keyboard navigation difficult.
findings.recommendation: Add visible focus styles (:focus-visible) to all interactive elements.

findings.title: Social media meta tags incomplete
findings.description: Open Graph image and Twitter Card tags are missing, reducing social media sharing quality.
findings.recommendation: Add og:image, og:image:width, og:image:height, and twitter:card meta tags.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
findings.description: No Permissions-Policy header is set. The page includes an embedded demo that could access camera/microphone.
findings.recommendation: Set Permissions-Policy to restrict unused features: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=().

findings.title: Subresource Integrity (SRI) missing
findings.description: 3 third-party scripts load without SRI hashes, increasing supply chain attack risk.
findings.recommendation: Add integrity and crossorigin attributes to all third-party script tags.

opportunities.title: Preconnect to third-party origins
opportunities.description: 2 analytics origins could benefit from preconnection to save 150ms on initial connection.

opportunities.title: Serve images in next-gen formats
opportunities.description: 3 decorative images could be converted to WebP for minor size savings.
